spans.s:
अमेध्य a.
1 Not able or allowed
to sacrifice.
--2 Unfit for a sacrifice;
नामेध्यं प्रक्षिपेदग्नौ

; 5. 126, 128; 12. 71.
--2 An
unlucky or inauspicious omen;
अमेध्यं दृष्ट्वा सूर्यमुपतिष्ठेत Kāty.
--Comp.
--कुणपाशिन् a. feeding on carrion.
--युक्त, --लिप्त a. smeared with ordure,
foul, defiled, dirty.
--लेपः smearing
with ordure.

Having no wife, a
widower.
--2 Not injuring or hurting.

अमेय a.
1 Immeasurable,
boundless; अमेयो मितलोकस्त्वं

.
[]
--2 Unknowable.
--Comp.
--आत्मन्
a. possessing an immeasurable soul,
magnanimous, large-minded. (--m.)
N. of Viṣṇu.

अमेष्ट a. [अम-इष्ट] Ved.
Sacrificed at home.

आमेन्य a. To be measured from
all sides; to be reached with an
arrow or bolt (?).
